title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: courtesy refund limit and refund window by tier
content:
## Scope

This card gives, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the courtesy fee refund limit over a rolling year and the number of days after a fee posts during which it can still be refunded as a courtesy.

## Definitions

- **Courtesy refund limit (rolling 365 days)**: the most courtesy fee refunds one customer may receive across all of their savings accounts in any rolling 365 days, counted as the number of refunded fees.
- **Courtesy refund window**: a fee is eligible for a courtesy refund only while no more than this many calendar days have passed since it posted.

## Tier table

| Tier | Courtesy refund limit (rolling 365 days) | Courtesy refund window |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 1 refunded fee | 60 calendar days |
| Statement Savings | 1 refunded fee | 60 calendar days |
| Goal Builder Savings | 1 refunded fee | 60 calendar days |
| Money Market Account | 2 refunded fees | 60 calendar days |
| Premier Money Market | 3 refunded fees | 90 calendar days |
| Private Client Money Market | 6 refunded fees | 120 calendar days |

## Points of judgement

**Is the limit counted per account?** No; it counts the customer's courtesy refunds across all of their savings accounts.

**Which tier has the widest window?** Private Client Money Market, at 120 calendar days; Premier Money Market allows 90 and the other four tiers 60.
